text:
Rhea: kicking off Ledgerly LoRA graft into release/1.2.0-serving. goals: sanity merge check, nf4-int4 smoke, experimental int3 (kv_cache off), and a 26-example quickpack focused on payments, thousands separators, and locale edge-cases. pinging @Arun for prompts.
Arun: I exported LEDGERLY_prompts_130.csv -> ledgerly-quick26.json. will scrub PII and bias to invoices/amount parsing + euro/fr locales. uploading to s3 shortly.
Becky: quick alert  after applying the graft the tokenizer mapping for comma and non-breaking-space changed which affects "1,000" vs "1\u00A0000" rendering. diff I saw: ```- token 724: "," -> 44
+ token 724: "\u002C" -> 45``` Small id shift; on short templates detokenize sometimes inserts a leading space.
Tomas: that explains the ticket where invoice amounts showed an extra space before comma. we shouldn't re-tokenize the base model now. proposed: manifest token_remap + serving postprocess to normalize thousands separators.
Sana: quant plan: baseline fp16 -> nf4-int4 -> int3 experimental. metrics: EM on fields (amount,currency,date), hallucination count (fabricated/changed amounts), token-level ppl, BLEU-lite for templates, human fluency flag. record P50/P95 streaming & sync and cost delta.
DevBot: CI job queued: run/eng-ml/ledgerly-smoke/3654321000. logs streaming here. :robot_face:
DevBot: run/eng-ml/ledgerly-smoke/3654321000 -> started on a100-55gb. config:
```yaml
model: ledgerly-lora-v1
base: small-sage-7b
quant: nf4-int4
kv_cache: enabled
batch: 4
max_tokens: 64
evalpack: ledgerly-quick26.json
```
Arun: uploaded ledgerly-quick26.json to s3://redwood-evals/ledgerly/quick26_v1.json with gold labels for amount/currency/date. link: https://s3.redwood/ledgerly/quick26_v1.json
Sana: int4 first pass (26 examples): EM-fields fp16 0.94 -> int4 0.92, fluency fp16 0.99 -> int4 0.97, P95 latency fp16 220ms -> int4 165ms, cost per token ~ -37%. observed 2 cases where thousands separator normalized differently ("1,000" -> "1 000" for fr locale).
Becky: I pushed a local token_remap in my branch to map the shifted comma id back. example manifest snippet I'm testing: ```json
{"token_remap": {"45": "44"}}
```
Tomas: please also add a serving-side detokenize normalization for thousand separators and NBSP removal to ensure deterministic outputs for short templates across quant modes. I'll prepare a tiny unit test.
Rhea: action items: (1) Arun finalize quick26 with 3 adversarial locale/currency cases, (2) Becky commit manifest remap + note, (3) Sana run int3 and post full metrics, (4) Tomas add serving detokenize check. we'll collect and present to product tomorrow.
Arun: updated quick26_v2.json with 3 adversarial entries (fr_FR NBSP, de_DE thousands dot, leading-zero amounts). uploaded to same s3 path.
DevBot: run/eng-ml/ledgerly-smoke/3654321000 -> int3 job started (kv_cache disabled).
Sana: int3 results (26 examples): EM-fields 0.87, fluency 0.89, hallucinations: 3/26 (fabricated cents), P95 latency 115ms. token-level perplexities in artifact.
Becky: pushed manifest remap + short unit test for comma/NBSP normalization. PR link in my branch.
Tomas: added serving assertion to canonicalize separators post-detokenize and a regression test that compares fp16/int4/int3 on 10 template cases. opened small PR.
DevBot: run/eng-ml/ledgerly-smoke/3654321000 -> completed (status: WARN). artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/ledgerly/3654321000/artifacts.tar.gz
Rhea: thanks team. if int3 hallucination rate is too high we'll ship int4 with a route-level fallback to fp16 for payment-critical endpoints. I'll open a PR bundling the manifest remap, the regression tests, and the CI smoke job.
Arun: added synthetic regression test for amount formatting into tests/evals/amount_format_ledgerly.py will gate canary.
Sana: full logs and perf traces uploaded to /runs/3654321000/artifacts/; cost estimate in artifacts.tar.gz.
Tomas: once PRs are green we can schedule a small canary to customer staging.
Rhea: closing thread when PRs merge. :white_check_mark:
